summary: Session 3 of 3 (FINAL): pilot + fresh-output verification + closeout for the harvester upstream-feedback-followups set. No production code changed this session; the classifier/question-generator/signal/schema implementation was already cross-provider verified in Sessions 1 and 2. (1) Pilot: ran identify-usage fresh against the committed HomeHealthCare IR (74 objects) and NorthwindDevEdition IR (167 objects), exit 0 both, hermetic on committed IR (no Access COM). The cumulative Session 1 + Session 2 signals fire as designed — HHC LauncherSurface x5 / ParameterizedInput x7; Northwind LauncherSurface x2 / StartupEntry x1 / ParameterizedInput x4. (2) Output review: launcher shells read clearly as NavigationShell launchers (0.8-0.85); tblSwitchboardItems reads as a switchboard config table (StandaloneUtility), no longer deletion-scented; parameter-dialog forms stay hedged Unknown @ 0.45 with a single ParameterDialogFlow question; parameterized queries keep both OutOfBandEntryPossible and ParameterizedQuery (additive). No local wording/threshold defect was exposed, so no calibration was made (Step 4 is conditional). (3) Checklist casing: a fresh run emits canonical PascalCase for BOTH fixtures (top-level Review; PascalCase item keys; no camelCase) — per the spec stop rule the verification is recorded and the writer left UNCHANGED (no casing code change). (4) Golden regeneration: regenerated the committed usage goldens for both fixtures to bake in the cumulative S1+S2 changes; the diff is the 3 new fired:false signal-type rows on every object plus the real changes on 12 HHC / 6 Northwind objects, with no objects added or removed; files LF-normalized per .gitattributes; the spurious samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb test-build timestamp churn was reverted and excluded. (5) Docs: no consumer-doc change warranted — reviewing-the-feedback-artifacts.md is intentionally high-level/vocabulary-agnostic and the new questions are self-describing; the concept vocabulary already lives in object-use-identification-strategy.md (S1/S2). Per the Lean-by-default principle no edit was made. (6) Build/test: dotnet build 0 errors (pre-existing CA1416/NU1903 warnings only); dotnet test AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests hermetic (excl. the Access-COM ComDateMaximaProbe tier) 816 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, including all S1 LauncherSurfaceTests and S2 ParameterDialogTests unchanged and green. Scope discipline held: no cleanup-pipeline changes, no COM changes, no duplicate-table-shape / obsolete-module-header heuristics, missing inbound references not treated as deletability. Cross-provider verification (gpt-5-4): R1 VERIFIED (empty issues) — a clean first-round close on the regeneration + casing stop-rule + pilot judgment. This is the final session; the set's top-level status flips to complete. The harvester arc is complete and the repo is in a consumer-driven-only posture (see next-session-set-recommendation.md): no self-initiated next set.
